description: Scan S3 for Bronze manifests to drive Silver processing
steps: Create `silver/discovery.py` with manifest scanner
Implement S3 listing for Bronze manifests: `bronze/{platform}/{entity}/dt={date}/run_id={uuid}/_manifest.json`
Filter manifests by date range, platform, and entity
Parse and validate manifest JSON against Bronze manifest schema
Return structured list of manifests with metadata (run_id, dt, row_count, files)

description: Stream Bronze JSONL.gz data referenced by manifests
steps: Create `silver/reader.py` with streaming Bronze data reader
Load JSONL.gz files referenced in manifest (handle multi-part files)
Parse JSONL records and yield Python dicts
Handle decompression and UTF-8 decoding
Add progress tracking (records read counter)

description: In-batch deduplication by dedup key with conflict resolution
steps: Create `silver/dedup.py` with deduplication engine
Implement in-memory dedup keyed by entity-specific dedup_key
Conflict resolution: latest wins by `updated_at` or `event_ts`
Track dedup stats: records in, duplicates dropped, records out
Log duplicate records for observability

description: Write normalized records to Iceberg tables via PyIceberg
steps: Create `silver/writer.py` with Iceberg writer
Convert normalized Python dicts to PyArrow RecordBatch
Append RecordBatch to Iceberg table via PyIceberg
Configure write properties: ZSTD compression, target file size 256MB
Atomic commit with transaction, capture snapshot ID
Handle write failures gracefully

description: End-to-end orchestrator: manifest → read → normalize → dedup → write
steps: Create `silver/processor.py` with end-to-end processing workflow
Orchestrate: discover manifest, read Bronze, normalize, dedup, write Silver
Add structured logging at each stage with metrics
Fail fast on normalization or write errors
Emit processing metadata: manifest processed, rows read/written, dedup count, snapshot ID

description: Integration tests for the full processing pipeline
steps: End-to-end test with mock Bronze manifest and data
Test deduplication within single run
Test Iceberg write and snapshot creation
Test error handling (malformed JSON, schema violations)
Verify PyArrow schema matches Iceberg schema
